entries.description: Safe .env.example for backend services integrating with external APIs. Empty placeholders for API_BASE_URL (base URL of the external service) and API_KEY (authentication token). Generic template applicable to any third-party REST API.
decision_rules: Use API_BASE_URL to allow URL switching between sandbox and production endpoints
Prefer bearer token (API_KEY) over username/password credentials for API authentication
anti_patterns: Never hardcode API keys in source code or Dockerfiles
Do not reuse a single API key across multiple services — provision separate keys per service
